summary: Twelve selected items form a strong, diverse set spanning model training, safety/containment, benchmarks, enterprise moves, open-source releases, AI finance, and an ML application story. One weak item (HighSignal_AI's low-engagement, vague Hassabis 'cure all disease' claim) is replaced with a stronger distinct reserve. The Anthropic rare-disease grants and Hassabis disease-cure items share a broad health-AI topic but cover distinct events/angles and are flagged rather than removed.
